classGuide.investor-impacting-outage: An investor-critical property is confirmed down or failing its authoritative critical path. Page immediately.
classGuide.outage: A non-investor-critical property is confirmed unavailable. Ordinary incident.
classGuide.degradation: Reachable but slow, intermittent, or failing a non-critical check.
classGuide.maintenance: Routine platform hygiene: expiring certificates, parked zones needing a topology decision, contract drift.
classGuide.observability-gap: We cannot see the property well enough to know its state (RUM off, single probe vantage).
classGuide.stale-evidence: Evidence exists but has aged past its freshness policy; automation may be failing.
classGuide.insufficient-evidence: The probe could not establish state (blocked/challenged, no contract). Not an outage.
classGuide.measurement-claim-block: An investor-facing claim cannot be made until the measurement is certified.
classGuide.business-opportunity: Upside that needs evidence before it is claimed.
classGuide.narrative-provenance: External or public narrative is inconsistent with the product.

derivation.note: Items with source "derived" are computed from probe, history, and inventory evidence on every collection run; source "manual" items are hand-authored judgments with no derivable evidence.

items.title: Certify human audience metrics
items.observed: The latest measured operational edge snapshot (2026-09-23.2) contains 36,391 raw visits, including 31,681 attached to a synthetic health path. Mission Control probes add tagged synthetic traffic that must also be excluded.
items.businessReason: Operational edge telemetry cannot responsibly stand in for human traction.
items.nextAction: Connect certified GA4/RUM-quality audience ingestion (history ingestion seam: certified-audience) with explicit bot, monitor, API, asset, and Mission Control probe exclusions.

escalation.escalateWhen: Any investor material attempts to present raw edge visits or requests as human audience before certification.

items.title: Instrument meaningful business conversion events
items.observed: No certified investor-facing funnel for subscriber, partner, donor, sponsor, licensing, or investor-intent conversion is connected.
items.businessReason: Traffic without conversion or retention evidence does not explain economic potential.
items.nextAction: Define the business-event taxonomy and connect first-party or GA4 event telemetry with source, window, and attribution limits.

escalation.escalateWhen: Investor materials require funnel or retention claims that cannot be sourced.

items.title: No production probe evidence has been collected
items.observed: The scheduled collector has not yet produced a valid probe run; every property availability is unknown.
items.businessReason: Without probes the estate can fail silently.
items.nextAction: Run the mission-control-evidence workflow (workflow_dispatch) and confirm it commits to the evidence branch.

escalation.escalateWhen: Still missing 24 hours after the collector was enabled.

items.title: Accumulate enough comparable history for 7/28/90-day trends
items.observed: 0 scheduled daily snapshots retained (0/90 days of a full 90-day view); 1 measured operational-traffic snapshot; certified audience history: none.
items.businessReason: Trend charts become decision-grade only when they contain comparable observations rather than decorative lines.
items.nextAction: Scheduled collection accumulates snapshots automatically; connect a governed Canonical Gold source (goldBindings) to add comparable operational-edge points.

escalation.escalateWhen: A chart attempts to calculate a trend from fewer than two comparable measured observations.

items.title: Quantify Culture Sherpa convergence opportunity
items.observed: Culture Sherpa remains prominent in the estate and conceptually aligned with GlobalDeets place context, but shared usage evidence is not yet connected.
items.businessReason: The integration thesis could improve differentiation and depth, but should be supported by actual overlap and utility evidence.
items.nextAction: Measure cross-navigation, overlap, unique utility, search demand, and content reuse before making convergence claims.

escalation.escalateWhen: Integration is presented as realized value before shared usage evidence exists.

items.title: Replace stale GitHub repository description
items.observed: GitHub still describes GlobalDeets as a portfolio and research intelligence showcase even though README, STATUS, and the live product have moved on.
items.businessReason: Repository metadata is visible during diligence and can reintroduce the obsolete product story.
items.nextAction: Update the repository description to the source-first world-information product narrative.

escalation.escalateWhen: Repository metadata remains inconsistent with the live product during external diligence.

items.title: Resolve 4 browser-observability gaps
items.observed: RUM is off for artificelligance.com, artificelligence.com, fwomps.com, fwomp.us; 21 of 25 zones are observed.
items.businessReason: Unobserved properties are harder to diagnose and cannot contribute comparable browser evidence.
items.nextAction: Enable RUM where appropriate or explicitly record an exemption with rationale.

escalation.escalateWhen: A currently unobserved property becomes business-critical or has a production incident.

items.title: Most properties lack an authoritative critical-path contract
items.observed: 0 of 25 properties have an authoritative critical-path contract; 0 have only a homepage identity baseline; 25 have no contract.
items.businessReason: Reachable-unverified is not verified health; only owned, contracted paths can prove the product works.
items.nextAction: Owners of each property declare a stable critical path (API endpoint, key page, or function) and add it to the registry.

escalation.escalateWhen: A property is described to investors as production-grade without an authoritative contract.

items.title: Remove remaining portfolio-era live copy
items.observed: GD-029 removes the remaining Data Platform Showcase language from categories.html.
items.businessReason: Live product surfaces should tell one coherent story.

escalation.escalateWhen: Portfolio-showcase language reappears on investor-adjacent live surfaces.
